title.ja: Firewall Manager: 複数アカウントの WAF、security group、Network Firewall をまとめて管理する
title.en: Firewall Manager: One Policy for WAF, Security Groups, and Network Firewall across Accounts

sources.title: AWS Firewall Manager
supports: Firewall Manager applies protections across the accounts and resources of an organization, including accounts and resources added later
Charges incurred by Firewall Manager are for the underlying services, such as AWS WAF and AWS Config

sources.title: AWS Firewall Manager prerequisites
supports: The prerequisite steps, in order: AWS Organizations, a default administrator account, AWS Config, the Marketplace subscription for third-party policies, AWS RAM sharing for Network Firewall and DNS Firewall policies, and Regions that are disabled by default

sources.title: Joining and configuring AWS Organizations for using Firewall Manager
supports: The account must be a member of an organization in AWS Organizations
The organization must have all features enabled; consolidated billing alone is not enough

sources.title: Creating an AWS Firewall Manager default administrator account
supports: Only the organization's management account can create the default administrator account
The default administrator has full administrative scope and is set as an AWS Organizations delegated administrator for Firewall Manager

sources.title: Enabling AWS Config for using Firewall Manager
supports: AWS Config must be enabled for each member account, including the Firewall Manager administrator account, and for each Region that contains resources to protect
The recording frequency must be Continuous
The resource types AWS Config has to record for each policy type, when not recording all resources
AWS Config can record CloudFront distributions only in US East (N. Virginia)
A custom IAM role for the recorder that lacks permissions is not visible to Firewall Manager

sources.title: Enabling resource sharing for Network Firewall and DNS Firewall policies with AWS RAM
supports: Network Firewall and DNS Firewall policies need sharing with AWS Organizations enabled in AWS RAM

sources.title: Using AWS Firewall Manager administrators
supports: An organization can have several Firewall Manager administrators, each with an administrative scope of accounts or OUs, Regions, and policy types
The default administrator can manage third-party firewalls and has full scope, and is otherwise a peer of the other administrators

sources.title: Creating a Firewall Manager administrator account
supports: Only the management account can create Firewall Manager administrator accounts
An OU in a scope includes the accounts of its child OUs, including ones added later

sources.title: Changing the default Firewall Manager administrator account
supports: When an administrator revokes their account, all Firewall Manager policies created by that account are deleted

sources.title: Disqualifying changes to a Firewall Manager administrator account
supports: Closing the administrator account deactivates its policies and stops their protections; policy data is kept for 90 days

sources.title: Using AWS Firewall Manager policies
supports: The policy types: AWS WAF (and AWS WAF Classic), Shield Advanced, Amazon VPC security group, Amazon VPC network ACL, Network Firewall, Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall, and third-party firewall (Palo Alto Networks Cloud NGFW, Fortigate CNF)
A policy is specific to one policy type, and several policies of one type can exist
A policy either reports non-compliant accounts and resources or remediates them automatically

sources.title: Creating an AWS Firewall Manager policy
supports: An AWS WAF policy for CloudFront distributions is created with the Region set to Global; other Regions need one policy each
With automatic remediation, a policy can also remove existing web ACL associations that are not managed by another active Firewall Manager policy, associating its own web ACL first
A content audit security group policy must be created without automatic remediation
Resource tags can include or exclude, not both in one policy
The creation of a policy can take several minutes

sources.title: Using the AWS Firewall Manager policy scope
supports: Scope by accounts: all, an include list of accounts and OUs, or an exclude list
Scope by resource tags: all of the tags or any of the tags, included or excluded; a tag matches on the same key and the same value
A resource that leaves the scope stays associated and protected unless the policy removes protections from resources that leave the scope
The AWS Config managed rules and web ACLs with no resources are deleted regardless of that option

sources.title: Deleting an AWS Firewall Manager policy
supports: Deleting a Shield Advanced policy leaves the accounts subscribed to Shield Advanced
Replica security groups of a common security group policy remain unless the cleanup option is chosen

sources.title: Using AWS WAF policies with Firewall Manager
supports: A policy either creates new web ACLs for all in-scope resources, replacing ones in use, or retrofits the web ACLs already associated
In a managed web ACL an account can manage its own rules and rule groups in addition to the policy's

sources.title: Rule group management for AWS WAF policies
supports: A managed web ACL has three sets: the policy's first rule groups, the account's rules and rule groups, and the policy's last rule groups
The first and last sets take rule groups only, not individual rules
The rule groups are named PREFMManaged- and POSTFMManaged- followed by the policy name and a timestamp

sources.title: Web ACL management for AWS WAF policies
supports: With optimizeUnassociatedWebACL, a web ACL is created in an account only if a resource will use it; without it, every in-scope account gets one
A web ACL the policy creates is named FMManagedWebACLV2-<policy name>-<timestamp>
Retrofitting (webACLSource RETROFIT_EXISTING) requires the web ACL to be owned by the account and associated only with in-scope resources
A customer-owned web ACL that a customer associates manually is still overridden by the policy's web ACL

sources.title: Logging for an AWS WAF policy
supports: A logging change made through AWS WAF on a managed web ACL is not detected automatically; re-evaluating the policy's AWS Config rule prompts an update

sources.title: Setting up AWS Firewall Manager AWS WAF policies
supports: Web ACLs that Firewall Manager creates cannot take part in CloudFront flat-rate pricing plans
After deleting a policy with its resources, the changes might take a few minutes to reach all accounts

sources.title: Using security group policies in Firewall Manager to manage Amazon VPC security groups
supports: Best practices: exclude the administrator account, start with automatic remediation disabled, and keep Firewall Manager and other tools from managing the same security groups
Changes to security groups on EC2 network interfaces are usually detected within several hours, and can take as much as six
Network interfaces created by Amazon RDS are not supported, and those of Fargate tasks and requester-managed interfaces cannot be updated

sources.title: Using content audit security group policies with Firewall Manager
supports: A content audit policy applies to customer-created security groups in scope, for the resource types EC2 instance, network interface, and security group
The audit security group is created in the administrator account and is only a comparison reference
With custom policy rules, allow means every in-scope rule must be within the allowed range of the audit group's rules; deny means none may be
With automatic remediation, Firewall Manager updates or removes non-compliant rules
Peer security groups cannot be referenced in a content audit policy

sources.title: Using common security group policies with Firewall Manager
supports: A common security group policy replicates primary security groups from the administrator account into the VPCs in scope and associates them

sources.title: Using usage audit security group policies with Firewall Manager
supports: A usage audit policy reports unused and redundant security groups and, with remediation, removes or consolidates them

sources.title: Using AWS Shield Advanced policies in Firewall Manager
supports: A Shield Advanced policy applies Shield Advanced protection to the chosen resource types

sources.title: Using Amazon VPC network ACL policies with Firewall Manager
supports: A network ACL policy enforces first and last rules in the network ACLs of in-scope subnets; accounts add rules in between

sources.title: Using AWS Network Firewall policies in Firewall Manager
supports: A Network Firewall policy creates and manages firewalls for the VPCs in scope, distributed, centralized, or imported

sources.title: Using Amazon Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall policies in Firewall Manager
supports: A DNS Firewall policy associates rule groups with the VPCs in scope, before and after the account's own associations

sources.title: Viewing compliance information for an AWS Firewall Manager policy
supports: Compliance is shown per account and per resource; a content audit policy has violation details for a security group rule, the referenced audit rule, the reason, and a suggested remediation
After a change to the policy or to in-scope resources, the compliance status may take several minutes to update
Firewall Manager detects changes through AWS Config, and rapid repeated changes can lose compliance or remediation state

sources.title: AWS Firewall Manager integration with AWS Security Hub CSPM
supports: Firewall Manager sends findings for non-compliant resources to Security Hub CSPM automatically when Security Hub is in use
The product name to filter on is Firewall Manager, case sensitive
Findings are not resolved for deleted policies, deleted resources, or resources that have left the scope

sources.title: AWS WAF policy Firewall Manager findings
supports: The finding 'Resource is missing Firewall Manager managed web ACL', severity 80, status PASSED or FAILED

sources.title: Security group content audit policy Firewall Manager findings
supports: The finding 'Security group is not in compliance with content audit security group', severity 70, status PASSED or FAILED

sources.title: AWS Config Firewall Manager findings
supports: The finding 'Account does not have AWS Config enabled in the Region'

sources.title: AWS Firewall Manager quotas
supports: Default quotas per Region: 50 policies per organization (Global and US East (N. Virginia) count together), 20 OUs in scope per policy, 8 tags that include or exclude resources per policy, 50 rule groups per AWS WAF policy, 1 audit security group per content audit policy
Fixed quotas: 10 administrators per organization, 5,000 WCUs for the rule groups of an AWS WAF policy

sources.title: AWS Firewall Manager notifications
supports: Firewall Manager records no CloudWatch metrics; Amazon SNS notifications are what it offers

sources.title: Using service-linked roles for Firewall Manager
supports: The service-linked role AWSServiceRoleForFMS lets Firewall Manager manage web ACLs, security groups, AWS Config rules, and other resources in each account

sources.title: How AWS Firewall Manager works with IAM
supports: The SNS topic policy statement that lets AWSServiceRoleForFMS publish, used with PutNotificationChannel

sources.title: Policy (Firewall Manager API reference)
supports: The fields of a policy: IncludeMap, ExcludeMap, ResourceType, ResourceTypeList, ResourceTags, ExcludeResourceTags, ResourceTagLogicalOperator, RemediationEnabled, DeleteUnusedFMManagedResources
With an IncludeMap, the ExcludeMap is not evaluated
The valid resource types for each policy type

sources.title: SecurityServicePolicyData (Firewall Manager API reference)
supports: The policy types as API values and the ManagedServiceData examples for WAFV2 and SECURITY_GROUPS_CONTENT_AUDIT
ManagedServiceData is at most 30,000 characters

sources.title: ResourceTag (Firewall Manager API reference)
supports: A resource tag without a value is saved with the empty string, and tags match only on the same key and the same value

sources.title: DeletePolicy (Firewall Manager API reference)
supports: What DeleteAllPolicyResources removes for AWS WAF and security group policies
Web ACLs that Firewall Manager generated and that are associated with nothing are removed even when DeleteAllPolicyResources is false

sources.title: PutNotificationChannel (Firewall Manager API reference)
supports: The notification channel is an SNS topic and an IAM role

sources.title: AWS::FMS::Policy
supports: The properties of the resource, including ResourcesCleanUp and DeleteAllPolicyResources, and that ManagedServiceData is a JSON string

sources.title: AWS::FMS::Policy IEMap
supports: The keys of the map in CloudFormation are ACCOUNT and ORGUNIT
sources.note: The API reference writes the OU key as ORG_UNIT. The stack uses the CloudFormation spelling.

sources.title: AWS::FMS::NotificationChannel
supports: The properties SnsRoleName and SnsTopicArn, and the example that passes the ARN of AWSServiceRoleForFMS

sources.title: Resource types that support Cloud Control API
supports: AWS::FMS::Policy and AWS::FMS::NotificationChannel are listed

sources.title: AWS Firewall Manager and AWS Organizations
supports: Enabling trusted access creates AWSServiceRoleForFMS in the accounts of the organization; standalone accounts cannot be managed by Firewall Manager
Only the management account can configure a delegated administrator for Firewall Manager

sources.title: OrganizationalUnit (Organizations API reference)
supports: The pattern of an OU ID

sources.title: Service control policies (SCPs)
supports: SCPs grant no permissions and set the maximum available permissions
SCPs do not affect the management account or service-linked roles, and they do apply to delegated administrator accounts

sources.title: AWS service integrations with Security Hub CSPM
supports: Firewall Manager sends findings to Security Hub CSPM, and the integration is active once Security Hub CSPM is enabled

sources.title: EventBridge event formats for Security Hub CSPM
supports: The format of a Security Hub Findings - Imported event; each event carries one finding

sources.title: Security Hub CSPM event types in EventBridge
supports: Every new finding and every update is sent to EventBridge; an administrator account also receives its member accounts' findings, and an aggregation Region those of linked Regions

sources.title: Configuring an EventBridge rule for Security Hub CSPM findings
supports: The event pattern for findings, filtered by finding attributes under detail.findings

sources.title: Required top-level ASFF attributes
supports: The attributes every finding has: AwsAccountId, CreatedAt, Description, GeneratorId, Id, ProductArn, Resources, SchemaVersion, Severity, Title, Types, UpdatedAt

sources.title: Optional top-level ASFF attributes
supports: ProductName, Compliance, RecordState, and Workflow are optional attributes

sources.title: AwsSecurityFinding (Security Hub API reference)
supports: RecordState is ACTIVE or ARCHIVED

sources.title: Publish (Amazon SNS API reference)
supports: A subject has no line breaks or control characters and is less than 100 characters long

sources.title: Using rule actions in AWS WAF
supports: Allow and Block are terminating actions: evaluation of the web ACL stops there

sources.title: Baseline rule groups
supports: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet uses 200 WCUs

sources.title: IP reputation rule groups
supports: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList uses 25 WCUs

sources.title: AWS Firewall Manager pricing
supports: A policy is priced with a monthly fee per Region; web ACLs, rules, and AWS Config rules that Firewall Manager creates are charged at the prices of those services
For Shield Advanced customers the policy fee is included

sources.title: AWS Price List: AWSFMS
supports: USD 100 per policy per month for an AWS WAF policy (usage type Policy-WAF, WAFv2) and for a security group content audit policy in ap-northeast-1

sources.title: AWS Price List: AWSConfig (us-east-1)

sources.title: AWS Price List: AWSConfig (ap-northeast-1)

sources.title: AWS Price List: AWSNetworkFirewall (ap-northeast-1)
supports: USD 0.395 per firewall endpoint hour in ap-northeast-1

sources.title: Cloudflare: Account-level WAF configuration
supports: Account-level WAF configuration applies rulesets to several Enterprise zones of an account and requires an Enterprise plan

sources.title: Cloudflare: Account-level managed rulesets
supports: Account-level rulesets run before zone-level rulesets, and a zone-level exception does not prevent a match at the account level

sources.title: Cloudflare: Organizations
supports: An Organization is a container for several accounts, available to Enterprise customers

sources.title: Vercel Firewall
supports: The platform-wide firewall with DDoS mitigation is on all plans, and the WAF's rules are ordered IP blocking, custom rules, managed rulesets

sources.title: Vercel WAF
supports: Custom rules and managed rulesets are configured for a project; managed rulesets are on the Enterprise plan
A configuration change takes effect globally within 300 ms

sources.title: Vercel WAF IP blocking
supports: IP blocking exists at the project level on all plans and at the account level on Enterprise plans

definition.ja: Firewall Manager の管理者アカウントに 1 つ作る設定で、保護の内容（WAF のルールグループや監査用のセキュリティグループなど）と、適用する範囲（アカウント、OU、リソースタイプ、タグ）を持つ。範囲に入るリソースには、あとから作られたものにも適用される。IAM のポリシーとは別のもの。
definition.en: A setting created once in the Firewall Manager administrator account: the protection (WAF rule groups, an audit security group, and so on) and the scope it applies to (accounts, OUs, resource types, tags). It applies to resources in scope, including ones created later. Not an IAM policy.

definition.ja: AWS Organizations で、アカウントをまとめる入れ物。入れ子にできる。Firewall Manager のポリシーや SCP で OU を指定すると、その OU と子の OU にあるアカウントすべてが対象になる。
definition.en: A container for accounts in AWS Organizations, which can be nested. Naming an OU in a Firewall Manager policy or an SCP names every account in it and in its child OUs.

glossary.ja: 委任された管理者（delegated administrator）

definition.ja: 組織の管理アカウントが、あるサービスの管理を任せたメンバーアカウント。Firewall Manager の管理者アカウントは、Organizations の委任された管理者として登録される。
definition.en: A member account that the organization's management account has entrusted with administering one service. A Firewall Manager administrator account is registered as an Organizations delegated administrator.

definition.ja: Firewall Manager のポリシーの設定。無効なら、ポリシーに合っていないリソースを報告するだけで何も変えない。有効なら、web ACL を関連付ける、ルールを消すといった変更を Firewall Manager がメンバーアカウントで行う。
definition.en: A setting of a Firewall Manager policy. Disabled, the policy only reports resources that do not comply. Enabled, Firewall Manager makes the change in the member account: associating a web ACL, removing a rule.

title.ja: Firewall Manager: 2 つのポリシーを 1 か月置いただけ（範囲に入るリソースが無い）
title.en: Firewall Manager: the two policies for a month, with no resource in scope

ja: AihFirewallManager と AihFirewallManagerEdge を何も変えずにデプロイした状態。自動修復はどちらも無効
範囲に入る OU に、CloudFront のディストリビューションもセキュリティグループも無い。web ACL は作られないと仮定（optimizeUnassociatedWebACL が true のため）
ポリシーの料金は 1 か月ぶん。月の途中で消したときに日割りになるかどうかは確認していない
CloudFront 用の AWS WAF ポリシーが、Price List のどの usage type（Policy-WAF、USE1-Policy-WAF、Policy）で請求されるかは確認していない。3 つとも USD 100
前提になる AWS Config の料金、Security Hub CSPM、通知用の Lambda・SNS・EventBridge・CloudWatch Logs は含めていない
en: AihFirewallManager and AihFirewallManagerEdge deployed as they are, with automatic remediation off in both
No CloudFront distribution and no security group in the OUs in scope. No web ACL is assumed to be created, because optimizeUnassociatedWebACL is true
The policy fee for a whole month. Whether it is prorated when a policy is deleted mid-month was not confirmed
Which Price List usage type an AWS WAF policy for CloudFront is billed under (Policy-WAF, USE1-Policy-WAF, or Policy) was not confirmed. All three are USD 100
AWS Config, which is a prerequisite, Security Hub CSPM, and the notifier's Lambda, SNS, EventBridge, and CloudWatch Logs are not included

items.basis: 1 security group content audit policy in ap-northeast-1

title.ja: Firewall Manager: アカウント 5 つの組織で、2 つのポリシーを 1 か月
title.en: Firewall Manager: the two policies for a month in an organization of five accounts

ja: 組織は、管理アカウント、Firewall Manager の管理者アカウント、ワークロードのアカウント 3 つ（dev、staging、prod）。ポリシーの範囲は、ワークロードの 3 つが入る OU
3 つのアカウントそれぞれに CloudFront のディストリビューションがあり、AWS WAF ポリシーの自動修復を有効にして、アカウントごとに web ACL が 1 つ作られる
ポリシーのルールグループ 2 つを、web ACL ごとにルール 2 つとして数えた。Firewall Manager がメンバーアカウントの web ACL に置くルールグループの数え方は、請求では確かめていない
web ACL 1 つあたり月 100 万リクエストを検査
AWS Config は、ワークロードの 3 つと管理者アカウントの計 4 つで記録する。記録する configuration item は、us-east-1 でアカウントあたり月 20 件、ap-northeast-1 で月 200 件と仮定。計測値ではない
ポリシーが作る AWS Config のルールの評価は、範囲に入るアカウントごと、ポリシーごとに月 100 回と仮定。計測値ではない
含めていないもの: Security Hub CSPM、AWS Config の記録を置く S3、通知用の Lambda・SNS・EventBridge・CloudWatch Logs。ポリシーの料金が日割りになるかどうかは確認していない
en: The organization: a management account, a Firewall Manager administrator account, and three workload accounts (dev, staging, prod). The policies cover the OU the three are in
Each of the three has CloudFront distributions, and with automatic remediation on, the AWS WAF policy creates one web ACL per account
The policy's two rule groups are counted as two rules per web ACL. How the rule groups Firewall Manager places in a member account's web ACL are metered was not confirmed on a bill
One million requests inspected per web ACL in the month
AWS Config records in four accounts: the three workloads and the administrator. 20 configuration items a month per account in us-east-1 and 200 in ap-northeast-1, assumed, not measured
100 evaluations a month of the AWS Config rule each policy creates, per account in scope, assumed, not measured
Not included: Security Hub CSPM, S3 storage for AWS Config's records, and the notifier's Lambda, SNS, EventBridge, and CloudWatch Logs. Whether the policy fee is prorated was not confirmed

items.basis: 1 security group content audit policy in ap-northeast-1

title.ja: Firewall Manager: Network Firewall のポリシーが作るエンドポイント 1 つを 1 か月（桁をつかむための例）
title.en: Firewall Manager: one endpoint created by a Network Firewall policy for a month (an order-of-magnitude example)

ja: この章のスタックは Network Firewall のポリシーを作らない。分散型のポリシーが範囲に入る VPC に置くファイアウォールのエンドポイント 1 つぶんの時間料金だけを示す
730 時間。処理したデータ量の料金（GB あたり）と、ポリシーそのものの月額は含めていない
en: This chapter's stacks create no Network Firewall policy. This is only the hourly price of one of the firewall endpoints a distributed policy places in the VPCs in scope
730 hours. The per-GB processing charge and the policy's own monthly fee are not included

note.ja: 7 ファイル 94 件。範囲の判定（include と exclude の map、子の OU、タグの AND と OR、あとから作られたリソース、タグで範囲から外れるリソース、クォータ）、セキュリティグループの監査のルールと CIDR の包含、テンプレートからのルールの読み取り、2 つのポリシーの managed service data、web ACL の関連付けのモデルと種を固定した 2,000 手の検査、finding のイベントと通知、料金の計算、2 つのスタックのアサーションとコンテキスト。モデルの判定を緩めると不変条件のテストが落ちることも確かめた
note.en: 94 tests in 7 files: the scope decision (include and exclude maps, child OUs, AND and OR over tags, a resource created later, a resource leaving by tag, quotas), the security group audit rule and CIDR containment, rules read from a template, the managed service data of both policies, the web ACL association model with a seeded walk of 2,000 steps, the finding event and the notice, the cost arithmetic, and assertions on both stacks and the context. Also confirmed that the invariant tests fail when the model's decision is loosened

note.ja: AWS のドキュメントが例に使うアカウント ID と、形だけ合わせた OU の ID で synth した。スタック 2 つ（AihFirewallManager はリソース 11、AihFirewallManagerEdge は 1）。コンテキストなしの `vp run fwm:infra:synth` が止まることも確かめた。合成された通知用の関数のバンドルを、テストランナーの外の Node.js で読み込んだ
note.en: Synthesized with the example account ID of AWS's documentation and an OU ID that only follows the documented shape. Two stacks (11 resources in AihFirewallManager, 1 in AihFirewallManagerEdge). Also confirmed that `vp run fwm:infra:synth` without context stops, and loaded the synthesized bundle of the notifier function in Node.js outside the test runner

note.ja: data/pricing の単価から、アカウント 5 つの組織の例を計算した。定価で月 USD 226.04。本文に載せた出力はこの実行のもの
note.en: Computed the example organization of five accounts from the unit prices in data/pricing: USD 226.04 a month at list price. The output quoted in the chapter is from this run

note.ja: その時点で cdk.out があった 46 個のテンプレートを読んだ。セキュリティグループ 7 つのうち、準拠 4、準拠していない 0、評価しないルールを含むもの 3。本文に載せた出力はこの実行のもの。ほかの章のファイルは変更していない
note.en: Read the 46 templates that had a cdk.out at the time. Of 7 security groups: 4 compliant, 0 non-compliant, 3 with a rule the model does not evaluate. The output quoted in the chapter is from this run. No file of another chapter was changed

summary.ja: 42章の 2 つのスタックを AWS に一度もデプロイしていない（組織が無い）。未確認: cdkd 0.296.28 が Cloud Control API 経由で `AWS::FMS::Policy` と `AWS::FMS::NotificationChannel` を作成・更新・削除できること、`IncludeMap` の `ORGUNIT` と文字列の `ManagedServiceData` が受け付けられること、Firewall Manager の実際の判定がこの章のモデル（範囲、タグ、「許された幅に収まる」、送信元がセキュリティグループのルール）と同じかどうか、`overrideCustomerWebACLAssociation` が false のときの既存の web ACL の扱い、リソースの作成から準拠の報告と web ACL の関連付けまでの時間、Security Hub に届く finding の実際のフィールドとアカウント、SNS の通知チャンネルに届くメッセージの内容、ポリシーの削除後にメンバーアカウントに残るもの、ポリシーの料金の日割りと usage type。
summary.en: The two stacks of chapter 42 have never been deployed to AWS (there is no organization). Unconfirmed: that cdkd 0.296.28 can create, update, and delete `AWS::FMS::Policy` and `AWS::FMS::NotificationChannel` through Cloud Control API; that the `ORGUNIT` key of `IncludeMap` and `ManagedServiceData` as a string are accepted; whether Firewall Manager's real decisions match this chapter's models (scope, tags, "within the allowed range", rules whose source is a security group); what happens to an existing web ACL when `overrideCustomerWebACLAssociation` is false; the time from a resource's creation to the compliance report and to the web ACL association; the real fields and the account of the findings that reach Security Hub; the content of the messages on the SNS notification channel; what stays in member accounts after a policy is deleted; and proration and the usage type of the policy fee.

resume.ja: 練習用の OU（アカウント 1〜2 個）を用意し、本文「デプロイして確かめる」の順に進める。Organizations のすべての機能、Firewall Manager の管理者アカウントの指定、対象のアカウントと管理者アカウントでの AWS Config（us-east-1 と ap-northeast-1、連続記録）、Security Hub CSPM を済ませたあと、`vp run fwm:infra:deploy -c adminAccountId=<ID> -c orgUnitIds=<ou-id>` と `vp run fwm:edge:infra:deploy`（同じコンテキスト）を実行し、コンソールで準拠の状態と違反の詳細を手元のモデルと比べる。次に `-c wafRemediation=on` と `-c sgRemediation=on` で再デプロイし、関連付けまでの時間、finding のイベントの実物（Notifier のログ）、SNS のメッセージを記録する。最後に 2 つの destroy を実行し、メンバーアカウントに残った web ACL と AWS Config のルールを確かめる。ポリシーは 1 つ月 USD 100。
resume.en: Prepare a practice OU with one or two accounts and follow the chapter's deploy page. After all features in Organizations, designating the Firewall Manager administrator account, AWS Config in the accounts in scope and in the administrator account (us-east-1 and ap-northeast-1, continuous recording), and Security Hub CSPM, run `vp run fwm:infra:deploy -c adminAccountId=<ID> -c orgUnitIds=<ou-id>` and `vp run fwm:edge:infra:deploy` with the same context, then compare the compliance status and violation details in the console with the local models. Deploy again with `-c wafRemediation=on` and `-c sgRemediation=on`, and record the time to association, a real finding event (the notifier's log), and the SNS messages. Finish with the two destroy tasks and check which web ACLs and AWS Config rules stay in the member accounts. Each policy is USD 100 a month.
